name: Fractal
summary: No LLM-generated content anywhere in the project, including code, documentation, issues and artwork. Translation into English must use non-generative machine translation such as DeepL.

evidence.quote: Contributions must not include content generated by large language models or other probabilistic tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Copilot.
This ban of LLM-generated content applies to all parts of the projects, including, but not limited to, code, documentation, issues, and artworks.
Translating texts for issues and comments to English can be achieved with machine translation tools, without the use of generative AI (LLM), such as DeepL.
